mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_id, member_pwd, member_name, nickname, email, profile ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{profile} )
INSERT INTO settings ( member_id, is_profile_public, is_word_tooltip ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, TRUE, TRUE )
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET is_verified = FALSE, verified_at = NULL, expired_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email} AND member_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verification ( email, code, expired_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{code}, DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) )
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET is_verified = TRUE, verified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE email = #{email} AND code = #{code} AND is_verified = FALSE AND expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verification WHERE email = #{email} AND is_verified = TRUE AND member_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verification SET member_id = #{memberId} WHERE email = #{email} AND is_verified = TRUE AND member_id IS NULL ORDER BY verification_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.member_pwd, m.member_name, m.nickname, m.email, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.profile, ''), '/images/common_member.png') AS profile, m.member_role, m.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(m.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, COALESCE(s.is_profile_public, TRUE) AS profile_public, COALESCE(s.is_word_tooltip, TRUE) AS word_tooltip, a.account_id, a.account_no, a.brokerage_id, b.brokerage_name FROM member m LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ( SELECT MIN(a2.account_id) FROM account a2 WHERE a2.member_id = m.member_id ) LEFT JOIN brokerage b ON b.brokerage_id = a.brokerage_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settings ( member_id, is_profile_public, is_word_tooltip ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{profilePublic}, #{wordTooltip} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_profile_public = VALUES(is_profile_public), is_word_tooltip = VALUES(is_word_tooltip)
mapper.select: SELECT brokerage_id, brokerage_name FROM brokerage ORDER BY brokerage_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( account_no, member_id, brokerage_id, owner_name ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{memberId}, #{brokerageId}, #{memberName} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'trade'
mapper.delete: DELETE t FROM trade t INNER JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId}
